title: Walking to School
text:
Many students walk to school every morning. Walking is healthy, and it costs nothing. However, some families live too far away, so they must use a bus or a car.

Therefore, many schools now encourage walking with safe routes. Although the program is new, it has already reduced traffic near some schools. As a result, parents feel more confident about letting their children walk.

questions.text: According to the passage, why do some families use a bus or a car?
What have many schools started to do, according to the second paragraph?
What can be inferred about the program mentioned in the second paragraph?
options: It has no effect on traffic
It is only for older students
It has already helped reduce traffic near some schools

questions.text: Why do parents feel more confident about letting their children walk?

vocabulary.definition: used to introduce a contrast with what was said before
the paths or roads that people take to get somewhere
made smaller in amount or number
feeling sure that something will be all right

paragraph_translations: Wielu uczniów każdego ranka chodzi do szkoły pieszo. Chodzenie jest zdrowe i nic nie kosztuje. Jednak niektóre rodziny mieszkają zbyt daleko, dlatego muszą korzystać z autobusu lub samochodu.

Dlatego wiele szkół zachęca obecnie do chodzenia pieszo, wyznaczając bezpieczne trasy. Chociaż program jest nowy, już zmniejszył ruch w pobliżu niektórych szkół. W rezultacie rodzice czują się pewniej, pozwalając swoim dzieciom chodzić do szkoły.
